BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electrical licensing and certificationrequirements applicable to contractors and persons working in theequipment repair specialty; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that, under currentlaw, persons who work in the equipment repair specialty are subject toelectrical licensing and certification requirements. It may beappropriate, however, to exempt some persons who do certain work whoare authorized by manufacturers to perform such work, who are or whoemploy factorytrained technicians to perform such work, or who are orwho employ persons who are otherwise qualified to perform certain work.
